name: NeoPixel 8x8 Matrix Rainbow 4
desc: This example demonstrates how to create a vibrant rainbow pattern on an 8x8 NeoPixel matrix using an Arduino. The circuit includes an Arduino Uno and an 8x8 NeoPixel matrix. The code generates a scrolling rainbow gradient across the matrix, creating a visually appealing effect. The brightness of the matrix can be adjusted in the code to save power and protect your eyes.
